text: {"final": {"summary": "In register_household (registry/register.py), added a validation check that runs only when the record explicitly supplies an 'id': it imports is_valid_household_id from core/ids.py and raises ValueError with a message including the rejected ID (e.g. \"invalid household id: HH-10471\") before any append/save, so the registry stays untouched. The check is placed alongside the existing ValueError checks (region, members, duplicate id). When 'id' is absent, no validation runs, so the auto-assign path via next_household_id/make_household_id keeps working.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
